## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Change type

- [ ] Documentation or policy
- [ ] Schema or taxonomy

## Evidence and review

- [ ] Material claims have assertion-level sources

- [ ] Sensitive infrastructure and personal data checks are complete

known limitations.
